items.title: Linear
items.note: The most beautiful product management tool on the internet. A masterclass in how software should feel.

items.title: Are.na
items.note: A quiet corner of the internet for collecting ideas without the noise of social media.

items.title: Sidebar.io
items.note: Five design links every day. I have not missed a day in years.

items.title: Marketing Examples
items.note: Real-world marketing breakdowns with actual numbers and screenshots. One of the best resources for anyone doing growth work.

items.title: Paul Graham's Essays
items.note: Required reading for anyone who thinks about startups, ideas, or how to live an interesting life.

items.title: Not Boring by Packy McCormick
items.note: Business strategy made genuinely fun. The best thing I have read each week, most weeks.

items.title: The Generalist
items.note: Long-form breakdowns of the most interesting companies. The kind of writing that makes you think differently.

items.title: Alex Hormozi
items.note: The most practical business content on YouTube. No fluff, just frameworks that actually work.

items.title: Kurzgesagt
items.note: Science and big ideas explained beautifully. I come here when I want my brain to feel small in a good way.

items.title: Notion
items.note: My second brain. Everything I know, plan, and track lives here.

items.title: Loom
items.note: The fastest way to replace a long email with a short video. Changed how I communicate with clients.

items.title: Perplexity
items.note: Search, but actually useful. My first stop for research now.
